issues.description: Numeric threshold used in the solution for Aufgabe 07 does not match the threshold specified in the problem statement. The problem requires Gemeinden with more than 75,000 male or more than 75,000 female inhabitants, but the solution uses 7,500 (missing a zero), which will produce incorrect results and confuse students about the intended criterion.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the numeric comparison in the solution to match the problem statement. Change the WHERE clause to use 75000 instead of 7500, e.g. WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000. Ensure any accompanying documentation or tests use the same threshold.
